# CHEEZ CORNER

CHEEZ CORNER is a wedding planning and event management company serving Patna, Bihar and suitable nearby areas. Catering is one supporting service within the wider event experience.

Primary website: https://chezcorner.cv/

Business contact: Caterer Rahul Singh

Phone: +91 9122555551
Email: cornercheez@gmail.com

Core services:
- Wedding planning and multi-function coordination
- Venue, vendor and production coordination
- Décor, lighting and stage design
- Photography, entertainment and hospitality coordination
- Wedding, reception, engagement and family event management
- Catering and food-service coordination
